title: Anathem
author: Neal Stephenson
summary: On the world of Arbre, scholars called avout live cloistered in monasteries apart from the outside world. When an alien object appears, young Fraa Erasmas is sent out into that world. The book mixes philosophy, mathematics and adventure.
readIf: you like long, idea-heavy novels with invented vocabulary and philosophical dialogues.
skipIf: you want a quick read or dislike a steep, slow start.
